messages:
alex-kr: FYI — ACME DEAL: customer wants a 2-week hands-on POC. Need a quick checklist and clear success criteria by EOD so we can lock dates.
priya-se: Thanks. Can we scope two tracks: 1) chat integration (low latency streaming) 2) batch embeddings for search tuning? Both in the same POC or separate?
alex-kr: Prefer single POC that shows both — they care about RAG chat latency and vector search relevance. Budget prefers one combined run.
jonah-pd: Agreed. For success criteria propose: (a) 95th-pct streaming latency < 450ms at 5 concurrent users, (b) embedding recall @k=10 > current baseline by +6%, (c) avg cost per 1M tokens < $X target. Also include no security blockers.
priya-se: I'll prepare evals. For chat: we should collect 120 prompts (mix of short/long) + 30 regression prompts for hallucination checks. For embeddings: 1k doc corpus with curated query set (50 queries).
mei-security: Send me the security questionnaire answers by tomorrow. Key items: data residency, KMS integration, audit logs, and token retention policy. We need to confirm we can offer VPC option for them.
alex-kr: They're asking about auth: prefer API key scoped to project, but will need SSO for production. For POC OK with API key + IP allowlist.
priya-se: Implementation notes for engineering: use the JS SDK (we'll ship a small example). Streaming snippet:

```js
const stream = client.chat.stream({model: 'xlarge', input: prompt});
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
```

Auth: set header `Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>` and IP allowlist on our side.
jonah-pd: Rate limits — propose we set a soft quota of 60 reqs/min (chat) and burst to 120 for short spikes. Retries: client should use idempotency for reruns; implement exponential backoff with jitter. Document this in the runbook.
priya-se: I'll add a small curl example for retries and a sample `Retry-After` handling snippet. Also will include guidance on KV cache usage to speed follow-up turns.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: POC sandbox cluster provisioned: rdw-poc-acme-01 in us-west-2 (GPUs: 2xA10g). Credentials posted to 1Password under Acme/POC.
alex-kr: Great. Timeline draft: Week 0 (kickoff + data ingest), Week 1 (integration + baseline runs), Week 2 (evals, tuning, final checklist). Can we compress to 10 business days?
priya-se: We can try 10 bd but ask customer to pre-send their sample docs and a representative prompt set a week before kickoff. Otherwise integration will slip.
mei-security: For the questionnaire items I need answers on: PII classes, retention window for request logs, and who in their org owns data deletion. Send answers to me privately and I'll sign off.
jonah-pd: Pricing question — they asked about reserved capacity vs hosted usage for steady load. Recommend Hosted for POC; show a cost projection and note Dedicated contract thresholds if they hit sustained 200k tokens/day.
alex-kr: I'll coordinate and ask them to confirm sample docs and the POC contact list. Priya, can you draft the runbook + eval plan by EOD?
priya-se: Yep — will post a short runbook in this thread with checklist items, curl/js snippets, quotas, and the eval rubric. Will tag @mei-security for signoff before kickoff.
alex-kr: Thanks team. If we get signoff today, I'll request 1Password keys and lock in the cluster start on Monday.
